sections.name: LocaleContext, readPersistedLocale, listeners, notify, getServerLocale, getBrowserLocale
sections.title: Language store, saved value reader and hooks
sections.what: Defines the default language, the storage key, and a reader that accepts only English or Hindi. Keeps a list of listeners, reads the saved language in the browser, uses English on the server, and reacts to changes from other tabs. The provider updates the page language attribute, and the hooks give components the language and text.
sections.why: Keeps the language consistent across the app and across tabs, and avoids a mismatch between server and browser output.
sections.watch_out: The server always returns English, so any code that changes this default can cause a mismatch that appears as a hydration error.

summary: Holds the chosen language for the whole app, saves it in the browser, and keeps all open tabs in step.
purpose: Lets every component read and change the language from one shared place.
why: Likely reason: the server must always start in English so it matches the first browser render. Reason partly stated in the locale test file.
how: Creates a shared context and a store that reads the saved language from the browser, defaults to English on the server, and listens for changes from other tabs. Setting a language saves it and notifies listeners. The document language attribute is updated to match. The hook functions give components the language and the translated text.
inputs: The saved language in the browser storage, and calls to set a new language.
outputs: The current language, a setter function, and the translated text.
risks: Saving an invalid language is blocked by the reader, but any new language must be added to the translation files too. Using the locale hooks outside the provider throws an error.
debug: If the wrong language shows, check the saved value under the storage key in the browser. If a tab does not update, check the storage event. If an error says the hook must be used inside the provider, check the page layout.
